phases.title: 1 · Welcome & background profile
notes: Maria starts on WhatsApp, a channel she already uses. No hold music, no IVR.
The Profiler Agent pulls account, PII and serviceability while the greeting is typed.
The agent confirms what it found instead of re-asking, which is the first moment of delight.
Today: the customer must call, and an agent re-keys what we already know.

phases.title: 2 · Need & sizing
notes: Intent is captured in her own words, then sized from the business profile (typical dental practice: 3–4 lines).
Pricing is shown up front. All pricing is illustrative demo pricing.
A top-performing rep recommends rather than interrogates.

phases.title: 3 · Numbers & porting
notes: About 90% of orders are ports, so we ask early.
One bill photo and one e-signature replace faxes and callbacks.
Port, CNAM and E911 checks run in parallel instead of being re-keyed into several systems.

phases.title: 4 · Package & upsell
notes: WhatsApp list message: three packages that differ by voicemail, auto-attendant, hunt group and Teams.
Natural upsell moment: Teams bundle (and mobile lines, offered and declined).
Hunt group makes sure front-desk lines ring together.

phases.title: 5 · Scheduling decision
notes: Today a truck is always rolled. The agent checks the CPE on file and decides self-install vs technician.
Three real slots are offered as quick replies, with no phone tag to verify the date.

phases.title: 6 · Secure payment
notes: Card data never enters the chat. A PCI-compliant hosted link captures it.
Only a token lands in the billing system.

phases.title: 7 · Quality guardrail & confirmation
notes: The Quality Agent validates all essentials before submission.
It catches the one missing detail (hunt group ring order) and Maria answers a single quick question.
Avoided: a bad first experience plus a call into customer care.
Read-back and one tap to confirm gives an order number.

phases.title: 8 · Provisioning, no human touch
notes: Order, prioritization, BroadWorks provisioning and gateway config run as one continuous flow.
Zero systems touched by humans, zero handoffs. Exceptions would route to human-in-the-loop approval.

phases.title: 9 · Activation day
notes: On the chosen date, the customer gets one WhatsApp message and taps Accept.
Port activation and a test call complete with no phone call to the customer.
Same-day order, activation on the customer's chosen date.

phases.title: Summary
notes: Zero calls, zero human system touches, six of six essentials captured.
Under the hood: Foundry agents plus MCP/API connectors, monitored in Azure with human approval for exceptions.
